integrity: All statements are proved symbolically with independent finite reproducibility checks. Finite tests cannot establish the infinite theorem; originality is assessed from accessible sources only. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts only distinct scattered-subsequence strings of whole complement-doubling blocks, not subsequence embeddings or distributions by length; no transcendence/algebraicity assertion for the growth constant. Equivalence in unindexed older literature remains possible.
title: A two-trace law for distinct scattered subsequences under binary complement doubling
